notes.title: Concept art of the Limper
notes.notes: [p]Sharing some concept art again! Here’s the Limper, the most basic enemy in [url="https://bsky.app/hashtag/DieDeep"]#DieDeep[/url]. It started as a simple “Zombie” grunt, but the artist made it look more like an alien-zombie mix… it even had a nose at first 👀[/p][p][/p][p]First time sharing this on Steam, just giving it a try! [/p][p]If you find it interesting, let me know in the comments 🙂[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225699/6a2eb5f141e240b9132dd543c808ba0234ca6e6b.png"][/img][/p]
